objects.name: Magister Ilvaren
objects.greeting: You have climbed a long way to be told to look up.|The Watcher fills a tenth of our sky and has never once blinked. We are its moon. Remember that when your troubles seem large.
objects.topics: The mine=The lamps did not fail. Something put them out. The dead walk the lower galleries - tell your Reeve to send blades, not lamplighters.; The serpents=The Vérnees come through where the sky is thin, over the Crystal Hollow.; The planet=We call it the Watcher. Its rings are ice, and older than this world.

objects.name: Scribe Thessaly
objects.greeting: Every scroll here is copied fair, and burns only once.
objects.stock: scroll of insight x2, scroll of frost x2, scroll of renewal x2, scroll of the storm x1, scroll of return x4, parchment x12, ink x8, crystal ball x1, crystal dust x6

objects.name: Apprentice Niv
objects.greeting: The Magister says I may use the great glass when I can find the far stone without a map.

objects.title: Word for the Magister
objects.offer: The lamps in the Copperpit went out a month ago. Magister Ilvaren at the Drurin Observatory reads such things in the sky. Ask what the Magister has seen, and bring me the answer.
objects.remind: The observatory stands on its hill, north-east of the town.
objects.thanks: The dead, in my mine. Then it is blades we need, not lamplighters. You have earned this.
objects.reward: coins x90, scroll of insight x1

objects.title: The far stone
objects.offer: There is a sighting stone on the knoll north-east of the hill. Stand at it for me and tell me it is still upright? I have a chart to finish.
objects.remind: The far stone: down the east path, on its own knoll.
objects.thanks: Still standing. Then my chart is right and the Magister is wrong. Do not tell the Magister.
objects.reward: scroll of haste x1, coins x30, crystal dust x2
